official.use: Feed photo at its tallest ratio, 3:4
official.stated: When you share a photo that has a width between 320 and 1080 pixels, we keep that photo at its original resolution as long as the photo's aspect ratio is between 1.91:1 and 3:4.

source.title: Image resolution of photos you share on Instagram
Reel size & aspect ratios on Instagram

official.stated: Should be 320 pixels wide and 320 pixels tall for best quality.

source.title: Facebook Page profile picture and cover photo dimensions

official.use: Page cover photo, fastest under 100 KB
official.stated: Loads fastest as an sRGB JPG file that's 851 pixels wide, 315 pixels tall and less than 100 kilobytes.

source.title: Facebook Page profile picture and cover photo dimensions

official.stated: Use images that are at least 1200 x 630 pixels for the best display on high resolution devices. The size of the image file must not exceed 8 MB.
Use JPEG, GIF, or PNG files under 2MB with recommended dimensions of 400x400 pixels.

source.title: Help with uploading a profile photo

official.stated: Header photo, also known as a "banner" (recommended dimensions are 1500x500 pixels).

source.title: Help with uploading a profile photo

official.use: Photo in a post, recommended width at the tallest ratio, 4:5
official.stated: Photo must be at least 552 (w) x 276 (h) pixels, but we recommend 1080 (w) pixels to better connect with your audience. The photo's aspect ratio can range from 3:1 to 4:5 (width:height). The size limit for an upload is 5 MB.

source.title: Add or change the cover image on your profile

official.stated: Cover image: 1512 (w) x 256 (h) pixels. All images must be PNG or JPEG files and have a maximum size of 3MB.

source.title: Image specifications for your LinkedIn Pages and Career Pages

official.stated: Minimum dimension for upload: 2048 x 1152 px with an aspect ratio of 16:9. File size: 6 MB or smaller.
We recommend using a 2:3 aspect ratio, or 1000 x 1500 pixels. Max file size: Desktop 20 MB, In-app 32 MB.

official.use: Video thumbnail, recommended size, uploaded from the phone app
official.stated: Have a resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels for videos, with a minimum width of 640 pixels for videos. For videos, try to upload a thumbnail with an aspect ratio of 16:9. Mobile: 2 MB for video thumbnails or 10 MB for podcasts.
